standard_prerequisites.name: Popescu's theorem
standard_prerequisites.use: Factors the subalgebra generated by the solution through a smooth R-algebra (the author's replacement proof redoes this step rather than deducing from theorem-approximation-property).

standard_prerequisites.name: Lifting a section along a smooth map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Algebra, lemma lift-section-smooth-morphism (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the etale R -> R' with kappa(m) = kappa(m') and the map B -> R'.

core_obligations: Subtract approximants c_i in R with a_i - c_i in m^N and rewrite the solution over the generators d_l of m^N; the substituted system g_j = 0 in R[x_{i,l}] has the solution (a_{i,l}) in R^wedge.
It suffices to solve g_j = 0 over some etale R' with trivial residue field extension at a prime over m.

The author redoes the earlier proof instead of deducing from the approximation theorem: let A be the R-subalgebra of R^wedge generated by the solution; R -> R^wedge is regular, so Popescu's theorem factors A -> B -> R^wedge with B smooth over R.

The lift-section lemma produces an etale R -> R' inducing an isomorphism R/m -> R'/mR' and an R-algebra map B -> R'; the images b_i of the solution generators in R' form the wanted solution, congruent to a_i modulo (m')^N.
proof_roadmap: Coefficient rewriting; substituted system; Popescu factorization; etale lifting with trivial residue extension.
difficulty_reason: A four-step replacement proof supplied in full by the author (an alternative to deducing from theorem-approximation-property); every step is carried.
